body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within 5 units. On a success against Harmony, it burns 1 die on its next Action.

surges.html: Choose one creature or object affected by this Action as the Rite's sympathetic link. The Rite may trigger from that link within 6 units as though it were at the Rite's location.
When this Rite's next Echo resolves, it may affect one additional eligible target.

rider.title: HEX RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: The hexed creature willingly moves more than 2 units on its turn. Echo: It suffers -1 Defense until the start of its next turn.
